items.title: Design Engineer
items.location_text: United States, San Francisco, Canada, New York, Toronto
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a design engineer to help build and maintain Waypoint, our design system, across both the Figma library and the production codebase. This is not a "designer who codes a little" or an "engineer who dabbles in Figma" role. You should be genuinely fluent on both sides, comfortable defining a component's behavior and states in Figma one hour and shipping the same component to npm the next. You'll take direct ownership of the Figma side of our library (structure, variants, tokens, documentation) while also contributing to the core Waypoint system: our component packages, our token pipeline, and the tooling that keeps design and code in sync. If the idea of being the single point of continuity between a Figma frame and a production component sounds exciting rather than exhausting, this is your role. We're also thinking beyond the system we have today. Waypoint isn't just meant to serve designers and engineers, it's meant to become something a model can read, reason about, and build with directly. We want someone who can help us get there: grounded enough to do the unglamorous work of making today's system solid, and forward looking enough to help define what an intelligent design system looks like next. WHY THIS ROLE Waypoint is still early enough that the decisions you make now will shape how the system scales. You'll have real ownership, not just a queue of component tickets, and you'll be working alongside a team that treats design and engineering as one discipline rather than two departments that hand work back and forth. And you'll be helping define what a design system becomes when it has to serve a third audience: the models that will increasingly build with it. RESPONSIBILITIES - Own and evolve the Figma library for Waypoint: component structure, variants, properties, and documentation, so it stays a reliable source of truth for design teams. - Build and maintain core Waypoint components, contributing directly to our component packages alongside the design engineering team. - Work across our token pipeline, keeping design tokens in Figma and their code representations (CSS custom properties, Tailwind config) tightly synced. - Partner with product designers to translate new patterns into system components, and with product engineers to make sure those components are easy to adopt correctly. - Help define and refine the workflows and tooling that connect Figma and code (sync scripts, plugins, documentation sites) rather than relying on manual handoff. - Write clear documentation and usage guidance so the system scales without you being the bottleneck. - Weigh in on system architecture decisions: when to add a new component versus extend an existing one, how to version and package changes, how to keep the system consistent as it grows. - Help shape how Waypoint evolves to serve a third consumer beyond designers and engineers: the model itself. That means thinking about how components, tokens, and patterns get structured so they're legible to AI systems, not just to humans. QUALIFICATIONS - 6+ years of combined design and/or engineering experience, with real depth in both. We care less about your job titles and more about whether you can move fluidly between Figma and code without losing fidelity in either direction. - Strong command of Figma at a systems level: component architecture, variants, auto layout, variables and tokens, and library management, not just using components someone else built. - Solid front end engineering skills, ideally TypeScript and React, with the ability to build accessible, well tested, production quality components. - Experience working with or building design tokens and understanding how they flow from design tool to codebase. - A systems mindset. You think in terms of reusable, composable patterns rather than one off solutions, and you can explain the tradeoffs of a system level decision to both designers and engineers. - Strong communication skills. You'll be the connective tissue between design and engineering, so you need to be able to advocate for system decisions to both audiences. - Comfort with ambiguity. Design systems work means constantly balancing consistency against the need to move fast and support new product surfaces. - A genuine interest in where design systems are headed, not just where they are. You should be able to hold the practical reality of today's system alongside a point of view on what it means to build for a future where AI is a first class consumer of your system, not just an afterthought. NICE-TO-HAVES - Experience building or contributing to design-to-code sync tooling (Figma plugins, token pipelines, MCP-based workflows, or similar). - Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and how to bake them into components rather than bolt them on. - Experience packaging and versioning component libraries for multiple consuming teams (npm scoped packages, semver, changelogs). - Exposure to multi-platform design systems work (iOS/SwiftUI, Android/Jetpack Compose, or token build tools like Style Dictionary). - Experience in an AI native product environment or genuine interest in how AI changes the way design systems get built and used. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. items.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist, Early Careers - EMEA
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a Talent Acquisition Lead, Early Careers, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of AI talent at Mistral. You will design, build, and run our global early careers strategy — spanning internships, graduate hiring, and campus recruitment — positioning Mistral as a premier destination for ambitious students and recent graduates in AI. This is a rare opportunity to build early careers programs from the ground up at one of the world's leading AI companies. You will own the full lifecycle of the intern and graduate experience: from sourcing and selecting high-potential talent through international school and university partnerships, to designing inclusive, well-structured programs that develop and convert that talent into future Mistral employees. Working from our Paris HQ, you will partner closely with hiring managers across all our departments to ensure early careers pipelines keep pace with our rapid global growth. 📌 Location: this role is located at our Paris, France HQ, with hybrid onsite collaboration. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Design and execute strategic early careers programs with clear goals for intern and graduate pipelines, aligned with Mistral's global growth plans and talent needs. - Partner with hiring managers and the People team to define role requirements, train and scale interview panels, and align on early careers priorities. - Own the end-to-end recruitment process for interns and early careers hires globally — from role definition and sourcing through offers and conversion decisions. - Build and maintain partnerships with top international schools and universities, creating sustainable, multi-year sourcing channels for high-potential candidates. - Build inclusive and equitable intern programs with structured learning objectives, meaningful core projects, and mentor/buddy pairing systems for every cohort - Drive global campus recruitment: represent Mistral at career fairs, host on-campus events, and develop targeted employer branding strategies for student markets. - Recruit, onboard, and lead a team of hands-on recruiters: set priorities, coach and develop the team, and scale capacity in step with hiring demand across geographies. - Build scalable systems and best practices: workflows, documentation, and tools to support rapid growth across geographies. - Embody our culture as an ambassador for Mistral, on campus and internally. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Proven experience: 7+ years in recruiting, preferably in tech, high-growth, or competitive environments. - Early careers depth: Exposure to global early careers, internships, or graduate recruitment - Team leadership: Demonstrated experience building, growing, and managing a team of recruiters in a fast-scaling environment. - Partnership expertise: Expertise in international school and university partnership development and global campus recruitment. - Program building: Demonstrated experience building inclusive and equitable intern programs, with excellent project management skills and exceptional attention to detail. - Data-driven mindset: Skilled at analyzing metrics to solve problems and optimize recruitment processes. - Global perspective: Experience with international hiring and fluent English communication; French is a plus. - Stakeholder influence: Ability to advise and align senior leaders with credibility and diplomacy. - Hands-on execution: Capable of balancing strategy with operational excellence, staying organized and disciplined across concurrent programs and locations. - Tool proficiency: Familiarity with modern ATS (e.g. Ashby), LinkedIn search, scheduling tools, and AI-driven productivity tools is a plus. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Product Designer, Growth
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Growth at Anthropic is about helping people discover what Claude can do and make it part of how they work, from someone's first session to an entire company rolling out Claude. We're a small design team working across all of Anthropic's products, on problems that often don't have established playbooks, because the products and the capabilities behind them change so quickly. We drive growth by making the product itself better, favoring foundational changes and new product experiences over small optimizations. Our focus spans whatever most limits Anthropic's growth, and priorities can shift quickly. As a senior Product Designer on Growth, you'll own how Claude grows with people who use it for their everyday work. You'll dig into why some people make Claude a habit and others don't, find the real bottlenecks, and lead the product changes that move them. You'll set the vision for this area, partner closely with product, engineering, and data science, and raise the quality bar for the designers around you. We're looking for designers who thrive in ambiguity and pair sharp diagnostic judgment with exceptional craft. You form a clear point of view from messy signals, prototype quickly to test it, and drive alignment across teams to ship it. You use tools like Claude Code to explore ideas and push what's possible. items.title: Account Director, Cyber
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) that benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals together in one lab. Our Go To Market (GTM) team helps customers understand and deploy our highly capable AI products across their businesses. Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnerships work together to bring AI to as many users as possible. ABOUT THE ROLE As an Account Director, Large Enterprise — Cybersecurity, you’ll work with some of our largest cybersecurity customers, winning new business and expanding adoption within existing accounts. You’ll help these organizations apply AI across their products, security workflows, and business operations. This role combines cybersecurity industry knowledge, technical understanding, executive engagement, and ownership of complex enterprise sales. You’ll create demand, develop opportunities, and lead deals from initial engagement through negotiation, deployment, and expansion. You’ll help executives identify where AI can deliver meaningful value and build a practical path to realizing it. We’re looking for someone with a hunter mentality and a strong track record in the cybersecurity ecosystem. You’re comfortable engaging CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, product leaders, and other business executives, bringing commercial and technical stakeholders together around an enterprise AI strategy. Success means both winning business and helping customers turn their commitments into sustained adoption and consumption. This role can be based in our San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle offices. We are also considering applications to work remotely from within the U.S. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU’LL: - Own a portfolio of large enterprise cybersecurity accounts, developing strategies that drive new business, enterprise adoption, and expansion. - Create demand through proactive prospecting, executive outreach, and a deep understanding of each customer’s business strategy, product roadmap, and security priorities. - Own complex deals end to end, including opportunity development, qualification, business case creation, technical evaluation, negotiation, and close. - Help executives identify opportunities to apply AI across cybersecurity products and workflows, such as security operations, threat analysis, incident response, and security engineering, in partnership with technical specialists. - Build relationships across security, engineering, product, business operations, and procurement teams, connecting stakeholders around shared goals. - Partner with solutions engineering to translate technical capabilities into customer programs with measurable business outcomes. - Navigate customer requirements around data privacy, sensitive security information, governance, and deployment, engaging the appropriate technical, security, and legal partners. - Win initial deployments and expand successful use cases across teams, business units, and geographies. - Own a consumption revenue target, partnering across the customer lifecycle to turn signed agreements into production usage and sustained growth. - Maintain rigorous account plans, opportunity management, and revenue forecasts, taking responsibility for advancing opportunities and resolving obstacles. - Bring cybersecurity customer and market insights to Product, Engineering, and GTM teams to inform our roadmap and approach. - Help build the processes, practices, and culture of a growing sales organization. WE’RE SEEKING SOMEONE WITH EXPERIENCE INCLUDING: - 14+ years selling complex platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service products to large enterprise customers, with substantial experience in cybersecurity. - Demonstrated success winning new customers and expanding existing accounts within the cybersecurity ecosystem. - A strong understanding of cybersecurity buyers, enterprise security workflows, and the commercial priorities of cybersecurity companies. - Generating pipeline and creating demand through proactive account development, including opportunities where the customer has not yet defined a project or allocated budget. - Designing and executing complex deal strategies with multiple decision-makers, technical requirements, security reviews, and procurement processes. - Selling across business units and functions, building support beyond a single buyer, team, or use case. - Working directly with C-level executives, including CISOs, CIOs, and CTOs, to connect technology investments to business strategy and measurable value. - Selling technically complex products in close partnership with engineering and solutions teams. - Navigating enterprise requirements related to data security, privacy, governance, and risk management. - Leading enterprise transformation opportunities from early discovery through deployment, adoption, and expansion. - Managing consumption-based revenue models, including forecasting usage, driving adoption, and identifying opportunities for growth. - Succeeding in fast-growing environments that require independent judgment, initiative, and accountability. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have a hunter mentality. You seek out opportunities, open doors, and build demand. You’re motivated by winning new customers and uncovering opportunities within established accounts. - Understand the cybersecurity landscape. You can engage credibly with security and product leaders, understand their priorities, and distinguish promising AI applications from those that require further evaluation. - Take ownership. You drive progress at every stage of a deal, set clear next steps, bring the right people together, and stay accountable when the path forward is unclear. - Can guide an executive journey. You meet leaders where they are, challenge their thinking thoughtfully, and help them develop a concrete vision for AI adoption. - Are customer-centric and commercially driven. You connect customer outcomes to durable growth and stay engaged as customers move from purchase to adoption. - Are technically curious. You enjoy understanding complex products and can explain their capabilities, limitations, and business implications to technical and nontechnical audiences. - Exercise sound judgment. You recognize the sensitivity of security use cases and work with the right partners to address customer requirements and support responsible deployment. - Think across the enterprise. You connect business units, build relationships across functions, and turn an initial use case into a broader adoption strategy. - Are a builder. You make sound decisions with incomplete information and help establish practices that allow a growing team to succeed. - Have a passion or deep curiosity for AI. You’re excited to help cybersecurity organizations deploy AI thoughtfully and deliver value to their businesses and users. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Backend Platform team’s mission is to enable fast, safe, and reliable backend development at scale. The team builds and maintains shared frameworks, libraries, and tooling that support hundreds of engineers working across backend services. By improving development workflows, strengthening security practices, and standardizing how services are built and maintained, this team plays a critical role in how quickly and safely products reach customers. You will help shape the foundation that backend engineers rely on every day! As a Staff Software Developer , you will set technical direction and lead large, multi-team initiatives that improve how backend systems are developed and operated. You will design and guide adoption of platform capabilities such as service frameworks, static analysis systems, and developer tooling. This role focuses on solving complex system-level challenges, influencing engineering practices across teams, and ensuring long-term scalability and reliability of backend development. You will also support engineers through technical guidance and contribute to planning and execution of major platform investments! This role is based in our New York City, New York office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. items.title: Vendor Admin Lead
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We are looking for a Vendor Admin Lead to own vendor master data for our global Finance Operations team. Reporting to the Director of Global Accounts Payable, you will be the single point of accountability for who our vendors are and get paid: onboarding, bank-detail verification, supporting documentation vetting, data quality and the controls around all of it. Anthropic's vendor base is growing quickly across the US, Europe and Asia-Pacific, and a clean, verified vendor data is what keeps a fast-growing company scale with the necessary controls. This role is deliberately separate from invoice processing and payments. You will control vendor records and bank details; you will not book invoices or move money. That separation is the point of the role, and you will own the SOX controls that enforce it and help design the access model that keeps it that way. items.title: Stage - Applied Research in GenAI / NLP F/M
items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: 💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us. 🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming! ENTER THE GAME We are looking for curious and rigorous minds to push the boundaries of Generative AI at Betclic. Our GenAI Center of Excellence builds and runs generative-AI applications for the whole group. Among them is a semantic-analysis platform that turns millions of raw texts (customer conversations, support tickets, news) into clear, actionable themes for several business teams. The method behind it is the one the AI labs use on their own data. Anthropic’s Clio makes sense of millions of conversations with Claude without anyone reading them; GitHub and Google Research have published the same recipe: embed the texts, cluster them, let an LLM name what emerges. Each runs it on its own data; almost nobody applies it to everyday business text. We do. You will join the GenAI Center of Excellence in Bordeaux, working with GenAI solution architects and will be exposed to business teams expressing analysis needs. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC As a GenAI Research Intern at Betclic, you will work on a question this field has not answered yet. Today, these systems group texts by what they are about. Grouping them by an angle you choose (tone of voice, urgency, intent) means paying an LLM to rewrite every document first. Can the representation itself be oriented, so that steering costs almost nothing? And before that: how do you prove that one clustering is better than another? Your missions will include: Mapping the state of the art in LLM-assisted clustering, steerable embeddings and clustering evaluation. Designing an evaluation protocol (reference corpora, metrics, LLM-as-a-judge) and measuring how far it can be trusted. Running controlled experiments that compare clustering pipelines, embedding models and orientation techniques, on real corpora as well as public benchmarks. Writing up your protocols and conclusions as research notes, and presenting them to the team and to business stakeholders. This internship will give you hands-on experience of the methods the AI labs use on their own data, and a research question you own end to end, from hypothesis to conclusion. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for curious, passionate and collaborative people who enjoy solving problems and working in a dynamic environment. This internship is for you if you: Are currently enrolled in a Master’s degree (or equivalent, final year) in Machine Learning, Data Science, NLP, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. Have strong analytical skills and scientific rigour, are autonomous, and care more about why something works than about making it work once. Are proficient in Python and at ease building with LLMs and agents : LLM APIs, prompting, tool calling, and AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow. Want to grow your skills in communicating experimental results clearly, including what they do not prove. Work comfortably in English or French. Nice to have : Previous exposure to embeddings, clustering or topic modelling (e.g. sentence-transformers, UMAP, HDBSCAN, BERTopic), or to LLM APIs. A first research experience: a lab internship, a paper, or a habit of reproducible experiments. An interest in sports or gaming industries is appreciated, but not required. WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? If your application is shortlisted, Maxime will contact you within a week for an initial HR screening (30 minutes). Then, you will complete the AssessFirst test (personality, motivation and cognitive reasoning). Next, you will meet your future manager. Finally, Maxime will conduct a final HR interview to review your AssessFirst results together. The recruitment process usually takes between 4 to 6 weeks to ensure an optimal experience for you. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT? 🎁 🍽️ A Ticket Restaurant® card credited with €10 per day (50% funded by Betclic) 🚆 50% reimbursement of public transport costs or a sustainable mobility allowance (€200 per year) 🏢 Extraordinary office space with a rooftop overlooking the Cité du Vin in Bordeaux 🎉 Internal events to brighten up your day-to-day life 🏋️ Free sports classes on-site And most of all, the opportunity to work in a young, fun, and vibrant atmosphere ! 6 months paid internship starting in February 2027 – Based in Bordeaux 📍 Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX All our positions are open to people with disabilities.

items.title: Software Engineer, HSM Infrastructure Security, Consumer Devices
items.description: We are hiring a Security Software Engineer to design and implement the hardware-backed security foundations used across OpenAI’s device ecosystem. A central focus of this role is hardening the boundary between our policy systems and the HSMs that protect sensitive cryptographic keys. This boundary determines which operations may be performed, what may be signed, which policies must be satisfied, and how changes to trusted software and policy are authorized. You will develop security-critical software and firmware within, or immediately adjacent to, an HSM trust boundary. Depending on your background, this may include HSM trusted applications, firmware services, cryptographic mechanisms, device drivers, PKCS#11 components, secure-provisioning protocols, or signing-policy enforcement systems. This is a hands-on software-engineering role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review production code, debug across hardware and software boundaries, and carry projects from initial requirements through deployment. It is not an HSM administration, PKI operations, compliance, or architecture-only position. In This Role, You Will - Design and implement security-critical software and firmware for HSMs, secure elements, trusted execution environments, and hardware roots of trust. - Build and harden the policy-to-HSM boundary responsible for authorizing certificate issuance and cryptographic signing operations. - Develop HSM trusted applications, firmware components, host interfaces, device drivers, SDKs, or cryptographic service integrations. - Implement or extend cryptographic interfaces such as PKCS#11, OpenSSL providers or engines, platform key-storage APIs, or comparable hardware-security interfaces. - Build firmware and software that cryptographically enforces key generation, provisioning, usage, rotation, recovery, and destruction policies. - Design and implement HSM-backed certificate authority, code-signing, key-management, and device-identity systems. - Develop end-to-end cryptographic protocols spanning devices, secure hardware, policy services, and backend infrastructure. - Build security capabilities supporting device attestation, secure boot, factory provisioning and restoration, user registration, and authentication. - Design controls that make trusted software and policy changes verifiable, auditable, and subject to appropriate multi-party authorization. - Write, review, test, and audit secure embedded software for resource-constrained environments. - Develop test harnesses, emulators, fuzzers, and fault-injection tooling to validate security properties and failure behavior. - Threat-model hardware and software trust boundaries and translate findings into concrete engineering improvements. - Partner with hardware, firmware, infrastructure, application, and security teams to integrate secure-by-default capabilities into production systems. - Help establish engineering standards for HSM development, applied cryptography, secure key management, and certificate infrastructure. Minimum Qualifications - 5+ years experience building secure embedded firmware for constrained environments - Deep programming experience in C, C++, or Rust. You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have - A strong track record of designing, implementing, debugging, and shipping production systems software. - Hands-on experience developing security-critical software or firmware within, or directly adjacent to, an HSM, secure element, TEE, or hardware root of trust. - Experience developing one or more of the following: - HSM firmware or trusted applications - Cryptographic mechanisms or hardware-accelerated cryptographic services - HSM device drivers, host libraries, SDKs, or middleware - PKCS#11 providers, mechanisms, or integrations - Secure key-provisioning or key-injection protocols - HSM-backed certificate authority or code-signing systems - Signing-policy enforcement within a hardware-backed trust boundary - Strong knowledge of applied cryptography, digital signatures, key hierarchies, secure key management, and cryptographic protocol design. - Experience with PKI, X.509 certificates, certificate authorities, certificate issuance, and certificate lifecycle protocols. - Familiarity with secure boot, measured boot, device identity, remote attestation, or hardware-backed storage. - Experience reasoning about concurrency, memory safety, privilege separation, hardware interfaces, failure modes, and side-channel or physical attack considerations. - The ability to evaluate security designs and personally implement the software required to realize them. - Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate across hardware, firmware, backend, and product teams. Additional Experience That May Be Helpful - Firmware development for ARM TrustZone or another trusted execution environment. - Experience with commercial or cloud HSM platforms such as Thales Luna, Entrust/nShield, Utimaco, Marvell LiquidSecurity, AWS CloudHSM, or comparable systems. - Experience with PKCS#11, KMIP, OpenSSL providers or engines, secure-element APIs, or platform-native key-storage frameworks. - Device manufacturing, secure provisioning, factory restore, or silicon bring-up experience. - Secure boot ROM, bootloader, firmware-signing, anti-rollback, or authenticated-update development. - Developing trusted applications or cryptographic services inside an HSM or secure coprocessor. - Hardware/software co-design involving cryptographic accelerators, secure processors, or custom silicon. - Multi-party authorization, quorum-controlled deployments, tamper-resistant audit mechanisms, or attestable policy systems. - Secure or private storage systems based on hardware-protected keys. - Experience sustaining high-assurance security software in production. items.title: GTM Systems Architect
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a RevOps Systems Architect to design and build the systems behind a modern, AI-powered go-to-market engine. This isn’t a Salesforce admin role, and it isn’t a support function. You’ll be the technical owner of how our GTM stack fits together: Salesforce at the core, surrounded by the data, enrichment, engagement, billing, and AI tools our revenue teams depend on. You’ll operate as an architect and a hands-on builder. You’ll set the technical direction for our CRM and GTM tooling, then ship it yourself with Flows, Apex, SQL, and custom services, including Salesforce MCP servers and AI tooling that make our CRM a first-class participant in AI-driven workflows. For larger efforts, you’ll partner with our engineering team, scoping, designing, and delivering together as a technical peer. In this role, you will: - Own the architecture of our GTM systems: the Salesforce object model and data architecture, how data moves between Salesforce and the rest of the stack, and the standards that keep it all healthy and scalable. - Design and build integrations between Salesforce and adjacent tools (data warehouse, enrichment, sales engagement, billing/CPQ, internal apps), choosing the right tool for each problem, whether that’s native Salesforce, Apex, middleware, or custom services. - Build and maintain automations using Flows, Apex, and custom services that power GTM processes end to end, with a bias toward solutions that are intelligent, observable, and maintainable. - Develop and maintain Salesforce MCP servers and AI agents that extend CRM functionality into AI-powered workflows, and define how AI fits into our revenue operations over time. - Design and own SQL-based data pipelines that feed dashboards and revenue reporting, making sure the numbers leadership relies on are trustworthy and traceable to source. - Translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical strategy, from stakeholder conversation through design, build, rollout, and adoption. - Raise the bar for the team: establish best practices for change management, testing, documentation, and technical debt, and mentor teammates on systems thinking. - Partner with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Engineering to prioritize the systems work with the highest business impact. REQUIREMENTS - 8+ years in Salesforce administration and development, with a track record of owning a complex, high-growth org and its architecture, not just maintaining it. - Strong Apex skills: you can design, build, debug, and maintain triggers, custom logic, and integrations independently, and you know when not to write code. - Demonstrated experience integrating Salesforce with other systems via APIs, middleware, or custom services, and designing for failure modes, data integrity, and scale. - SQL proficiency: you decompose ambiguous questions into well-structured queries and are comfortable with complex joins, aggregations, and pipeline logic. - A systems mindset: you can hold an end-to-end GTM process in your head, trace a field from origin through every downstream dependency, and anticipate what breaks when something changes. - Strong judgment and ownership: you scope problems yourself, make sound build-vs-buy and architecture calls, and drive projects to completion with little direction. - Clear communicator who can explain tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and earn trust across teams. - Excited by AI-native systems and curious about where Salesforce, MCP, and AI agents intersect. You’re already experimenting in this space. Bonus: - Familiarity with dbt or modern data transformation tooling. - Experience with BI tools such as Sigma or Looker. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood's Internal Audit team provides independent, objective, and timely assurance on the effectiveness of our governance, risk management, and internal controls — helping strengthen the frameworks that keep Robinhood and its regulated entities running with integrity. We partner closely with Robinhood Markets (RHM) leadership, the Company's Board of Directors, and its Committees to surface risk insights and drive meaningful improvements across the business. RHM is the parent company of Robinhood's lines of business, including Brokerage, Crypto, and Cash services. We're looking for a Senior Manager, Crypto Operations to join the Internal Audit team and help us build a best-in-class audit practice for one of the most dynamic areas of our business. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you'll do Execute audits within Operations, Compliance, and Technology for our crypto business as outlined in the Internal Audit Plan Support Audit leadership in conducting risk assessments, crafting the audit plan, and shaping the strategic direction of the Internal Audit program Own Internal Audit objectives that align with company goals and audit strategy Coordinate end-to-end audit procedures, including hands-on testing, report writing, issue validation, and oversight of team members and third-party providers supporting audit activities Present audit ratings and recommendations to senior management, C-suite members, management boards, and the parent company Audit Committee Develop and maintain relationships with senior leaders and risk partners, sharing insights on industry standards, audit regulations, regulatory requirements, and global implications Continuously improve the Audit practice by developing frameworks, metrics, procedures, partnerships, communications, and training programs Participate in special projects including regulatory inspections, third-party inquiries, and other duties as assigned What you'll bring Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or Computer Engineering 10+ years of experience in compliance or operations within a large, fast-growing financial services company, with strong project management and leadership skills 7+ years of expertise in financial services, including technology auditing Risk management, regulatory, and compliance experience across cryptocurrency, banking, trading, and money services/payments Experience evaluating processes and controls within a crypto exchange, market maker, custody provider, broker-dealer, or similar financial institution Strong track record of executive reporting and presenting to C-suite leadership, Company Boards, and Regulators Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills with strong attention to detail Strong analytical skills and sound judgment when evaluating complex business issues Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver in a fast-paced environment CIA, CISA, or cryptocurrency-related certifications preferred What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life and disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $170,000 — $200,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $150,000 — $176,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $133,000 — $156,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. This is a fully remote role, for a US-licensed attorney, preferably based on the West Coast, to join Payward’s world class in-house legal department, reporting to the Global Head of Labor & Employment. THE OPPORTUNITY - Serve as a senior member of the Labor and Employment (L&E) legal team, sharing the day-to-day workload with the Global Head of L&E and the broader team - Work with executive leadership, existing employment counsel, Payward Experience (PX), and other teams to develop L&E practices for rapidly growing global/worldwide workforce - Advise the company on worker classification issues, employee separations, executive compensation agreements, compensation plans, and wage-and-hour matters - Advise the company on risk mitigation for trade secret matters, and restrictive covenants - Support employment and labor due diligence for M&A transactions and advise on post-closing workforce integration, including harmonizing employment terms, policies, and compensation and benefits programs across acquired employee populations - Provide expert strategic input to the business and recruiting teams on expanding Payward’s global footprint, including EOR and direct employment decisions, transitions between EOR, direct employment, and contractor models for new markets and acquired workforces, global mobility, contingent workforce, and the related worker classification risks - Work closely with the PX team and business leaders to craft on-point policies and procedures, and to develop and deliver related manager and employee training, for a successful global/worldwide workplace - Advise on data privacy issues affecting employees and candidates - Support the PX team with global workplace investigations and employee relations matters involving whistleblower allegations, discrimination, and personnel performance issues - Manage outside counsel on pre-litigation, arbitration, and local-law matters, and coordinate with litigation counsel on employment disputes - Help build and refine AI-enabled workflows for the L&E team, such as contract review, policy drafting, and diligence, and set practical guardrails for their use - Monitor and advise on global L&E trends including those within the cryptocurrency industry to help Company’s competitive adaptability, talent acquisition and retention, and workplace processes - Additional duties and responsibilities as assigned WHAT YOU BRING - 10+ years of legal experience advising in the US and other jurisdictions on Employment, Labor, and Executive Compensation issues, to include in-house and law-firm experience working with companies in both high-growth scaling and mature, large-enterprise environments - items.title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners . You will strengthen our relationships with key partners to accelerate indirect revenue, enable their AI practices, and execute on long-term GTM strategy. Responsibilities: Strategic Technical Partnership : Be a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team, providing technical expertise to better understand the partner landscape, driving key strategic programs, and identifying opportunities to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues. Joint Solution Development: Collaborate with partners to identify high value industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures / best practices to accelerate time to deployment Customer Deal Support: Intervene directly to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance. Partner Ecosystem & Events : Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities. Product Feedback: Validate and gather feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver this feedback to relevant Anthropic teams to inform product roadmap and partner strategy. You may be a good fit if you have: 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing/partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer Track record of successfully partnering with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more Strong presentation & technical communication skills with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. As a Senior Software Engineer , you’ll architect, build, and scale the backend services, infrastructure, and data systems that support Robinhood’s next-generation crypto, web3, and wallet offerings. You’ll provide technical leadership to deliver a best-in-class trading experience for cryptocurrencies and tokenized assets—including perpetual futures—to customers worldwide, solving complex distributed systems and correctness challenges in an environment where the systems you build move real customer assets continuously around the clock. The Robinhood Wallet team’s mission is to democratize access to financial services worldwide by leveraging DeFi protocols and Robinhood Chain. The team builds non-custodial consumer products, self-custody experiences, and seamless cross-chain trading capabilities. The Tokenization team’s mission is to bring both public and private equity to be tradable 24/7 on decentralized exchanges (DEXs) across the Robinhood Chain. Equity markets have been closed nights and weekends for a century; the team builds the connective tissue between traditional market infrastructure and on-chain systems—issuance, custody, and settlement—to change that. The Robinhood Chain team designs and scales the underlying decentralized infrastructure across Robinhood. The team continuously improves Robinhood Chain to provide a best-in-class decentralized platform for trading real-world assets, builds specialized smart contracts, and provides infrastructure services for other Robinhood teams that rely on DeFi. This role is based in our Toronto office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Build scalable systems and components, making the right tradeoffs to account for stability and long-term maintainability. Design, write, test, and release critical technical solutions with high engineering rigor. Collaborate with multi-functional teams and deliver large-scope technical quality projects Mentor junior developers on the team and lead project of large complexity Find opportunities to improve system performance, team efficiency, and minimize risks What you bring 5+ years of software development experience working in a fast paced environment. 3+ years experience writing low latency, large scale distributed systems for Crypto domains. Proficiency in Go or Python, with exceptional technical grasp with problem-solving and production debugging skills. Strong ownership and experience building and operating high-scale, distributed systems across the full software lifecycle. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team and across engineering teams. Experience mentoring junior developers and leading the team technically on new initiatives and system improvement. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs Our team is committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming interview experience for all candidates. If you require a specific accommodation during the application or interview process due to a physical or mental condition, please complete this Applicant Accommodation Form to notify our team. The form should only be completed if you need a specific accommodation. Applicant Accommodation Form Vacancy Notice: This job posting represents an existing vacancy that we are actively seeking to fill. items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As an HR Business Partner, you will support managers and employees throughout the employee lifecycle while helping Mistral AI build scalable people practices as the company grows. You will be a trusted partner, providing guidance on people matters and helping leaders make informed decisions. You will work across both day-to-day people topics and longer-term initiatives, from employee relations and career development to performance reviews, learning, and talent retention. You will play a key role in creating a consistent employee experience across multiple countries while ensuring compliance with local employment regulations. You will also help shape how the People team operates by improving policies, processes, and programs that support the business and reinforce Mistral AI's culture. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Partner with managers to provide trusted guidance on people-related matters. - Support a positive and productive work environment by proactively addressing employee concerns and engagement. - Use People metrics to inform decisions and provide insights to managers and leadership. - Champion and reinforce Mistral AI's culture across the organization. - Develop and evolve talent retention initiatives that support long-term employee growth. - Design and improve learning, career development, and performance review programs. - Build scalable People policies and processes that promote sustainable ways of working, including work-life balance. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. items.title: Privacy Program Manager
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking an experienced Privacy Program Manager to join our Legal Team and help build and scale ElevenLabs’ global privacy program. In this role, you will translate privacy requirements into effective, repeatable processes across the company and drive the day-to-day operation of key privacy initiatives. You will work closely with Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, Safety, and GTM teams to operationalize privacy-by-design, manage privacy assessments and compliance workflows, and strengthen the systems and processes that support ElevenLabs’ growing global business. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep privacy program experience with strong project management skills and enjoys building scalable programs in a fast-moving AI environment. RESPONSIBILITIES - Manage and continuously improve ElevenLabs’ global privacy program, translating legal and regulatory requirements into scalable operational processes and controls. - Own and coordinate privacy compliance workflows across frameworks including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, HIPAA, and applicable biometric privacy requirements. - Manage privacy impact assessment processes, including Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), and assessments involving AI systems, biometric data, voice technologies, health information, and other sensitive data. - Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Security teams to operationalize privacy-by-design throughout the product development lifecycle. - Maintain data inventories, records of processing activities (RoPAs), data flow documentation, and other privacy governance records. - Manage processes for data subject and consumer rights requests, including access, deletion, correction, and opt-out requests, and help ensure requests are handled consistently and within applicable deadlines. - Partner with Security and Legal on third-party and vendor privacy assessments, data processing requirements, and privacy-related risk remediation. - Support privacy incident response and regulatory or customer inquiries by coordinating documentation, stakeholders, timelines, and follow-up actions. - Implement and administer privacy tooling and automation to improve the efficiency and scalability of privacy operations including maintaining ElevenLabs’ consent management platform and partnering with Legal, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to ensure cookie, tracking technology, and other consent and preference mechanisms are appropriately configured, documented, monitored, and updated as our products and regulatory requirements evolve. - Develop privacy program metrics, dashboards, and reporting to track compliance, identify risks, and communicate program maturity and priorities to stakeholders. - Develop and maintain privacy policies, procedures, playbooks, templates, and internal guidance. - Coordinate privacy training and awareness initiatives across the company. WHO YOU ARE - Excited by AI and emerging technologies and interested in solving novel privacy challenges involving voice, biometrics, health information, and other sensitive data. - An exceptional program manager who can turn complex requirements into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes. - Comfortable operating across Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, and commercial teams and able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Highly organized and detail-oriented, while able to prioritize effectively and maintain momentum across multiple workstreams. - Pragmatic and solutions-oriented, with a strong instinct for building processes that manage risk without creating unnecessary friction. - Comfortable building programs and processes from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. WHAT YOU BRING - 6+ years of experience in privacy program management, privacy operations, data governance, compliance, or a related field, ideally within a technology, SaaS, or AI company. - Demonstrated experience operationalizing privacy requirements under frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other US state privacy laws as well as sector specific frameworks such as HIPAA and biometric privacy requirements. - Technical mindset, you can read a data flow diagram, understand system architectures and keys to data handling and can translate between legal requirements and engineering implementation. - Experience building or significantly improving privacy review processes, privacy impact assessments, or privacy control frameworks. - Hands-on experience managing consent management platforms and cookie/tracking technology compliance, including consent configuration, preference management, and coordination with technical and marketing teams. - Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar. - Privacy certifications such as CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT are a plus. - Excellent project management, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed in the United States. We have a strong preference for the Eastern time zone, ideally New York. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
