items.title: Privacy Counsel
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking an experienced U.S. based Privacy Counsel to join our Legal Team. In this role, you will help shape and scale ElevenLabs’ global privacy program as the company continues to expand internationally. You will advise on privacy, data protection, and AI governance issues across our products and operations, while supporting commercial transactions involving data processing and technology services. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Security, and GTM teams to provide practical, business-oriented guidance that enables innovation while ensuring compliance with evolving privacy and AI regulatory frameworks across multiple jurisdictions. RESPONSIBILITIES - Advise on global privacy and data protection laws, including CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA, and other U.S. and international regulatory frameworks. - Advise on privacy and regulatory risks relating to AI systems, biometric data, voice technologies, and other sensitive data types. - Partner with Product and Engineering teams to implement privacy-by-design principles and support responsible development of AI products. - Conduct and oversee privacy risk assessments, including Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs)and related documentation. - Support commercial transactions by advising on data protection terms, including Data Processing Addendums (DPAs), Business Associate Agreements (BAAs), cross-border data transfers, and privacy provisions in customer agreements. - Monitor and interpret evolving legal and regulatory developments relating to privacy, AI governance, and data use, and translate them into practical guidance for the business. - Help develop and maintain ElevenLabs’ privacy policies, procedures, and governance frameworks. - Support responses to privacy-related regulatory inquiries, audits, and incidents, working closely with Security and Safety teams. WHO YOU ARE - Curious about the future of AI and emerging technologies, with a strong sense of ownership and enthusiasm for applying privacy law to cutting-edge products. - Comfortable navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments with evolving regulatory landscapes. - Able to translate complex legal requirements into clear, practical guidance for product and business teams. - Collaborative, pragmatic, and solutions-oriented, with a strong commitment to enabling innovation responsibly. WHAT YOU BRING - JD with active membership in at least one U.S. state bar (New York preferred). - 6+ years of relevant legal experience, with a focus on privacy compliance and data governance. - Experience advising AI, technology or SaaS companies on global privacy compliance and data governance. - Experience advising on US biometric privacy laws and regulatory requirements, including laws governing biometric identifiers and information. - Experience advising on HIPAA, healthcare privacy, PHI, and BAAs, particularly in connection with technology or SaaS products. - Experience advising on AI, data use, or emerging technology regulatory frameworks is a strong plus. - Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar. - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed in the United States. We have a strong preference for the Eastern time zone, ideally New York. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Strategic Delivery Lead, Federal Civilian & State and Local Government
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The OpenAI for Government team brings frontier AI to public institutions to help them achieve their missions. We partner with government leaders, mission owners, and technical teams to deploy AI tools responsibly, with the reliability, security, and support needed for meaningful use. Our Federal Civilian and State & Local Government business supports public institutions across a broad range of missions. We help these customers apply frontier AI to public services, knowledge work, research, and mission operations through hands-on delivery, tailored enablement, and collaboration with their teams. ABOUT THE ROLE The Strategic Delivery Lead (SDL), Federal Civilian & State and Local Government, will shape and deliver high-impact AI engagements across federal civilian agencies and state and local governments. You will turn customer priorities into practical deployments and sustained use, helping government leaders and mission teams apply OpenAI technology to public services, knowledge discovery, and operational workflows. This individual contributor role reports to the leader of Federal Civilian and State & Local Government. You will work alongside Account Directors and Applied AI Architects across assigned engagements, coordinating Research, Product, Engineering, Policy, Security, and Enablement resources. Account Directors own commercial strategy, contracts, and quota; you own delivery coordination, adoption, and customer outcomes, without an individual sales quota. You will lead execution across customer and OpenAI workstreams: define scope, milestones, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and success measures; surface risks; resolve blockers; and communicate progress to agency executives, program leaders, and working teams. You are accountable for agreed delivery commitments and customer acceptance. Engineering and Product teams remain responsible for technical implementation and operation of the systems they own. This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role combining senior relationship leadership with hands-on execution. Success requires sound judgment, technical fluency, strong program management, and the ability to turn executive alignment into useful technology in government teams’ hands. This role is based in Washington, DC, with domestic travel for high-value customer engagements, workshops, and delivery milestones. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Build trusted relationships with senior government leaders, program owners, and technical and mission teams to identify priorities and turn senior alignment into actionable engagements. - Own delivery plans for assigned federal civilian and state and local government engagements, with clear milestones, accountable owners, customer acceptance criteria, and measurable mission or operational outcomes. - Translate customer and mission needs into requirements and decisions that engineers, domain experts, and senior leaders can act on; communicate progress, limitations, risks, and dependencies clearly. - Connect customer mission and technical teams with OpenAI Research, Product, and Engineering teams to assess promising applications and move feasible opportunities into scoped, supported projects. - Coordinate the Applied AI Architect, specialist engineers, and customer technical teams on architecture, data access, evaluation, integration, and deployment requirements. - Build sustained adoption through practical enablement, user feedback, workflow support, and repeatable playbooks that can be applied across agencies and government customers. - Lead executive reviews and focused workshops in Washington and at customer sites, bringing the right decision-makers and technical experts together to resolve issues and advance delivery. - Identify security, data, infrastructure, contractual, and resourcing risks early; work with the accountable teams to resolve them and escalate decisions promptly. - Prioritize across a small, matrixed team, make clear trade-offs, and maintain momentum as customer needs and model capabilities evolve. - Coordinate with Account Directors, policy colleagues, and partners on broader government engagement, while keeping delivery commitments aligned with available resources and approved capabilities. YOU’LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have 10+ years of experience leading complex technical programs, customer delivery, or transformation initiatives, including substantial work with federal civilian agencies, state or local governments, or comparable public institutions. - Can meet customer-specific access requirements. An active DOE Q and/or U.S. Government TS/SCI clearance is preferred for engagements involving national security missions. - Are willing to travel domestically when an in-person engagement materially advances customer priorities, relationships, or delivery; use Washington-based engagement and remote collaboration effectively. - Understand how government executives, program owners, acquisition stakeholders, and technical teams make decisions and deliver work; navigate organizational boundaries to turn priorities into execution. - Have led complex AI/ML, enterprise software, API, cloud, scientific computing, or digital transformation engagements through implementation and sustained adoption. - Bring executive presence and a record of influencing senior government leaders, while remaining personally accountable for follow-through with working teams. - Translate mission goals into practical execution plans, acceptance criteria, and measures such as workflow adoption, staff productivity, output quality, and time to a validated outcome. - Have enough technical fluency to evaluate AI use cases, challenge assumptions, and work credibly with architects and domain experts on data integration, model evaluation, and deployment trade-offs. - Are curious about frontier AI and actively experiment with the technology to understand its capabilities, limitations, and applications to government work. - Build durable partnerships across mission teams, engineers, security teams, program owners, and executives; thrive in ambiguity and take initiative in a fast-moving environment. - See yourself as a bridge between frontier AI research and practical mission impact, with the judgment to distinguish a promising demonstration from a validated outcome. - Help customers use AI responsibly, with appropriate data protection, human review, provenance, reproducibility, and validation suited to the mission and use case. - Existing relationships across federal civilian agencies or state and local governments are valuable. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241. items.title: Research Engineer - Eval Platform
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE Evaluation is how we decide which models, checkpoints and recipes ship. As a Research Engineer on the Eval Platform team, you will build the infrastructure every science team relies on to measure model quality, and make it reliable, reproducible and fast. You don't need to have designed benchmarks before. You do need to care about what a score means, and about when a difference between two runs is real. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Build systems that keep eval results reproducible and comparable over time, as models, benchmarks and code evolve. - Run evaluations at scale across our GPU clusters, from model serving to scoring. - Make eval results easy to access, explore and trust, through APIs and dashboards that researchers use every day. - Catch broken or noisy evals before they mislead research decisions. - Support evaluation of agentic, multi-turn and tool-using models. - Work closely with researchers to turn new evaluation needs into robust, shared tooling. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Master's or PhD in Computer Science, or equivalent experience. - 4+ years building production-grade software, ideally large-scale ML codebases or distributed systems. - Excellent Python and strong software-design instincts: testing, code review, CI/CD. - Experience running workloads on GPU clusters (Slurm, Kubernetes, Ray or similar). - Familiarity with LLM inference and evaluation. - A product mindset: researchers are your users. - Self-starter, low-ego, collaborative. NICE TO HAVE - Experience building or maintaining evaluation harnesses or benchmarks. - Hands-on experience with inference engines such as vLLM or SGLang. - Experience with agentic or RL environments. - Statistics for experimentation: variance estimation, significance testing. - Open-source contributions to ML tooling. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. Our brands are used by hundreds of thousands of users and growing. A taster of what you will be involved with We want to be pioneers in a highly competitive market, so we continuously strive for technical and product excellence. As part of our team, you will be building new products and features using latest technologies; actively contributing to a state-of-the-art native, which is supporting our core brands. You have a strong sense of customer value and will participate in the whole value-chain discussion to contribute the how and what to make our products successful. You will be able to feel strong ownership of the things we deliver and our success. Scalable and performant applications Design and implement clean, scalable, and high-quality code with unit testing experience. Solving problems and have good software architecture knowledge. With more than 2,800 colleagues representing over 75 nationalities across a global network of offices - including 1,500 at our operational headquarters in Malta - every day brings new challenges and opportunities to grow. It may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you thrive on innovation, enjoy pushing boundaries and want to be part of a diverse, international team, then you’ll fit right in at Betsson. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability. Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems. Responsibilities: Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market You may be a good fit if you have: 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems Comfortable with Python Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? We’re looking for a Senior Human Resources Business Partner (12 Month FTC) to shape people strategy and drive meaningful outcomes at Easygo—a crew surpassing 1,500 globally, powering Stake and KICK, two of the world’s largest online entertainment and livestreaming platforms. You’ll partner with senior leaders across some of our most technical and innovative teams, close to where fast-moving decisions get made. You’ll have the autonomy to understand complex business challenges and shape how our teams grow in a business moving at pace. What you’ll build with us: We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time, 12-month fixed-term opportunity at our Melbourne office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. No two Service Lines run the same playbook here, so you’ll understand each one’s context, diagnose what’s holding it back, and build people plans that move it forward. You’ll partner with senior leaders on organisational design, workforce planning, and the structural decisions that shape how divisions scale, taking ownership of delivery and connecting the business with the expertise and support P&C offers. Who is Easygo? We’re a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Strategic Partnership Build deep business context for your portfolio and be a trusted advisor to leaders and their teams. Co-create people plans with your leaders, grounded in data, that set out the problems to solve and opportunities to chase. Partner with senior leaders on organisational design, workforce planning, talent strategy and performance, helping build effective team structures and leadership capability as the business scales. Use data and insights to diagnose root causes, coach leaders and orchestrate delivery through the right centres of excellence. Cyclical Program Execution Lead the delivery of cyclical people programs across your portfolio, so every area gets a consistent experience. Make cyclical programs count as real data and feedback loops, not compliance checkboxes. Work with centres of excellence to keep improving how these programs run. Employee Relations & Leadership Enablement Give pragmatic guidance on ER matters, from performance management to separations, keeping outcomes fair and compliant. Coach leaders to handle people matters themselves, reducing day-to-day reliance on HR over time. Lead formal investigations and complex ER matters end to end. Spot patterns in ER activity and surface systemic risks to leadership with recommended fixes. Your track record: Proven senior partnering experience, owning and delivering business outcomes through a people lens. A track record of coaching and influencing senior leaders, holding a position and landing tough messages without losing the relationship. Building and executing people plans grounded in data and measurable against commercial outcomes. Managing the full spectrum of ER matters, from performance management to complex separations, across Australian employment law. Leading cyclical people programs like performance cycles, remuneration reviews and workforce planning, on time and to a high standard. Strong commercial acumen and data literacy, talking business numbers first and turning workforce insights into a compelling story. Experience partnering with leaders across technical, product or similarly complex business functions, with an understanding of the workforce challenges, talent dynamics and organisational structures that support high-performing teams. Bonus points if you also have: Experience across centres of excellence, knowing what TA, L&D, Reward, Talent, Work Ex, Internal Comms and People Ops do and how to orchestrate them.. Familiarity with people tech platforms, engagement and performance tools. Tertiary qualification in HR, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Benefits that give you the Easygo Edge, so you can build the future of fearless tech with us: Disrupt: we push boundaries and play to win Ballots for major sporting and music events Time with our partners and ambassadors, and exclusive office sessions with leading streamers, creators and industry guests Spin the Wheel Fridays on your birthday and work anniversary, with prizes up to $1,000 or a car EV subscriptions, energy savings through Origin, and everyday discounts and cash back through Paylab Rewards Evolve: we’re in constant motion, personally and professionally The ultimate sandbox: 1 in 3 of our people level up their role every year. If you deliver, you move. Market-synced pay and a high-value referral bonus 30 days combined annual and personal leave for full-time employees 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers and 2 weeks for secondary carers, plus a 12-week return to work with fully paid Fridays off Employee Assistance Program for you and your family, and 7% off Bupa health cover with extras waiting periods waived Wednesday massages, a meditation space, parenting facilities, and bike storage, lockers and showers for active commuters Unify: we move as one and win together Daily catered breakfast, free barista coffee, juices and smoothies, and snack walls and drink fridges on every floor Pool tables, table tennis, gaming consoles, an F1 simulator, social sports teams and the Corporate Games Mid-year and end-of-year celebrations, team budgets for wins and milestones, and a paid volunteer day each year Benefits apply to Australian-based employees, are subject to eligibility and program terms, and may change. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

items.title: Accounting Manager
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Controllership team provides accurate, timely, and decision-useful financial information while building the processes, systems, and controls needed to support a rapidly growing global business. Our Accounting Operations team owns core accounting and close activities and drives improvements that help our finance organization scale. About the Role We are looking for an Accounting Manager with a strong general accounting foundation and hands-on intercompany experience to join our Accounting Operations team. You will own accounting and close activities across assigned balance sheet and P&L areas, manage intercompany activity for assigned entities, and build efficient, well-controlled processes. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with responsibility for independently managing accounting processes, exercising sound judgment, and reviewing work performed by outsourced partners. You will partner closely with Tax, Treasury, Strategic Finance, and Business Systems to resolve issues, support business growth, and improve how we work. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Own the close for assigned accounting areas, including accruals, prepaids, and other balance sheet and operating expense accounts, ensuring accurate results and timely completion. - Prepare and review journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules; resolve accounting issues and maintain clear, audit-ready documentation. - Manage intercompany accounting for assigned entities, including cross-charges, reconciliations, and coordination of settlements. Investigate differences and drive timely resolution with counterparties. - Support consolidation activities, including intercompany eliminations, entity-level validations, and foreign currency accounting, in partnership with the consolidation lead. - Analyze balance sheet and P&L movements, develop clear flux commentary, and partner with Strategic Finance to explain business drivers and variances. - Coordinate and review work performed by outsourced accounting partners, setting expectations for quality, timeliness, and issue escalation. - Own and improve internal controls within assigned processes, maintain process documentation, and support external audits. - Drive process improvements and automation, partnering with Business Systems to improve Oracle workflows, strengthen data quality, and reduce manual work through tools and AI-enabled solutions. - Support new entities, acquisitions, and business initiatives by establishing accounting workflows and integrating them into the close. You might thrive in this role if you have: - 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, with demonstrated ownership of close processes and experience reviewing others’ work or managing in outsourced support. - A strong general accounting foundation and practical knowledge of U.S. GAAP, including accruals, reconciliations, and financial statement analysis. - Hands-on intercompany accounting experience, including recording transactions, reconciling balances, and resolving differences across entities. - The judgment to independently resolve routine and moderately complex accounting issues, identify risks, and escalate matters with clear recommendations. - Experience operating and improving internal controls and supporting financial statement audits. - Proficiency with ERP systems and advanced Excel skills; Oracle Fusion experience is preferred, and exposure to Oracle FCCS or another consolidation system is a plus. - A track record of improving accounting processes, with curiosity about automation and AI tools. - Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage competing deadlines and work effectively across teams. - CPA qualification and/or public accounting experience is preferred. Experience in a global, multi-entity or high-growth technology company is a plus. items.title: Senior Manager, Occupancy Planning & Workplace Strategy
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI’s Real Estate & Workplace (REW) team creates and operates the spaces that support our people and our mission. Within REW, the Strategic Occupancy Planning team connects business needs, workplace strategy, and space data to help shape where and how our teams work. We partner closely with business leaders, Finance, People, Workplace Operations, and Design & Construction to anticipate growth, optimize space utilization, and deliver a thoughtful, scalable workplace experience. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for an experienced Occupancy Planning & Workplace Strategy Manager to lead strategic space planning for our Go-to-Market (GTM) and General & Administrative (G&A) organizations. In this role, you’ll translate evolving business needs into actionable occupancy strategies, capacity scenarios, and workplace recommendations. You’ll serve as a trusted partner to business leaders, balancing growth projections, operational requirements, and employee experience to inform decisions about how our teams use space. You’ll own planning across a complex, evolving portfolio while leveraging CAFM/IWMS systems and data analytics to drive accurate, scalable decision-making. This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, hands-on technical expertise, and strong cross-functional partnership to turn planning recommendations into operational outcomes. This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week, with approximately 10–20% travel. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Own strategic occupancy planning for GTM and G&A organizations, translating headcount forecasts, business priorities, and workplace needs into actionable space plans. - Develop and evaluate capacity scenarios, neighborhood strategies, team adjacencies, seating models, and space allocation recommendations to support organizational growth. - Partner with business leaders and executive stakeholders to understand evolving requirements, communicate trade-offs, and align workplace strategies with business objectives. - Collaborate with Finance, People, Analytics, Design & Construction, and Workplace Operations to reconcile forecasts, assess capacity constraints, and guide planning decisions through implementation. - Translate workplace needs into practical stacking, blocking, and move plans, ensuring recommendations account for operational feasibility, timing, and employee experience. - Leverage CAFM/IWMS platforms and analytical tools to maintain accurate space inventories, floor plans, seating allocations, and utilization data. - Identify and resolve space data discrepancies, establish quality controls, and partner with internal system owners and external vendors to improve data reliability. - Develop dashboards, planning workflows, and reporting tools that improve visibility into occupancy trends, capacity risks, and portfolio performance. - Drive continuous improvement in occupancy planning processes, including opportunities for automation, system enhancements, and scalable planning practices. - Support workplace change initiatives by partnering with cross-functional teams to ensure clear communication, coordinated execution, and successful transitions. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Bring 5–8+ years of experience in occupancy planning, workplace strategy, space management, or a related field, with experience independently managing complex, multi-team or multi-site portfolios. - Have a strong track record of translating business growth, headcount projections, and workplace requirements into practical, data-informed space strategies. - Possess hands-on experience with CAFM/IWMS platforms, including space inventory management, floor plans, seating allocations, data reconciliation, and reporting. - Are highly analytical and comfortable developing scenarios, evaluating trade-offs, and translating complex data into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders. - Excel at building trusted relationships with business leaders and cross-functional partners, influencing decisions without direct authority. - Can balance long-term strategic planning with hands-on execution in a fast-paced environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. - Have experience supporting workplace transitions, flexible seating strategies, organizational growth, or large-scale space planning initiatives. - Communicate clearly and effectively, whether presenting recommendations to executives, documenting planning assumptions, or coordinating implementation across teams. - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying opportunities for process improvement, and building scalable solutions. Experience with OfficeSpace or comparable CAFM/IWMS platforms, CAD or floor-plan tools, business intelligence platforms, system migrations, and vendor management is a plus. items.title: Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Startups
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role: As a Manager of Startups Applied AI Architects at Anthropic, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by leading a team of technical architects to help startups build AI-native products with the Claude Developer Platform. Your team is expected to win the trust of founders and engineers by supporting their technical ambitions from early product to scale. You'll bring your own builder credibility and startup instincts to the role — setting the vision for what great technical partnership looks like in the startup segment, developing a high-performing team, and personally carrying relationships with Anthropic's most strategic early-stage accounts. This is a role for a proven technical go-to-market leader who knows how to build teams that move at startup speed, earn the trust of deeply technical buyers, and turn a scrappy early engagement into a lasting technical partnership. You'll define the playbooks for nurturing and scaling new customers, set the bar for technical excellence, and grow the people — while staying close enough to the ground to know what's actually working. You will partner with sales leaders and work as one team to support your customers. Responsibilities: Lead, develop, and grow a team of Startups Applied AI Architects — setting a high bar for technical credibility, customer impact, and startup-paced execution Drive team performance through clear goal-setting, regular coaching, and a culture of continuous technical development Personally lead pre-sales engagements with high-priority startup accounts, from initial technical discovery through deployment and expansion, modeling what great looks like for your team Build and own the segment's technical playbooks: how to run technical evaluations, develop customer-specific eval frameworks, architect LLM solutions for resource-constrained early-stage teams, and win against competitive alternatives Partner with aligned Account Executives and GTM leadership to shape segment strategy and drive Claude API adoption across the startup ecosystem Ensure your team consistently surfaces insights on how startups are building with Claude — emerging use cases, deployment patterns, architectural decisions — and translate that signal into actionable feedback for Product and Engineering Drive cross-functional influence across Sales, Product, and Engineering to advance startup customer needs and shape roadmap priorities Build Anthropic's technical presence and credibility in the startup ecosystem through events, conferences, workshops, and content Stay ahead of the AI engineering landscape — context engineering, eval frameworks, agentic architectures, developer tooling — and ensure your team is operating at the frontier You may be a good fit if you: Have 8+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, or similar), with 5+ years leading and managing pre-sales or technical go-to-market teams Have a strong track record of building and developing high-performing SA teams — you know how to hire well, coach effectively, and create an environment where technical talent grows and does their best work Have deep experience working with startups or high-growth technology companies — you understand the velocity, constraints, and culture of early-stage companies and know how technical decisions get made at each stage of the journey Bring genuine builder credibility: you've built and deployed LLM-powered applications, you speak the language of founders and founding engineers, and you can earn the trust of deeply technical audiences without relying on a title Have hands-on expertise with context engineering, LLM evaluation frameworks, and modern AI architectures, and can guide both your team and customers through the decisions that separate a prototype from a production-grade system Are comfortable with Python and fluent in the LLM frameworks, tools, and integration patterns common in startup engineering stacks Are energized by building in ambiguous environments — you're excited to define the playbook, not just run it, and you thrive in fast-moving contexts where the technology and the customer segment are both evolving rapidly Have a genuine passion for making powerful technology safe and societally beneficial Strong candidates may have: Experience as a technical founder or in a founder-led sales motion, giving you firsthand understanding of what technical buyers in the startup world are actually evaluating A track record of winning competitive technical evaluations against other LLM providers Experience building foundational team infrastructure from the ground up: hiring frameworks, onboarding programs, technical playbooks, and coaching systems in a high-growth environment Deep familiarity with how developer infrastructure procurement evolves from seed through Series B and beyond, and how to adapt your team's approach accordingly A visible technical presence in the startup or AI engineering community through conference talks, written content, or open-source contributions The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $315,000 — $380,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. items.title: Direct Tax Lead
items.location_text: Remote, Europe, United States, New York
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring a Direct Tax Lead to own our US income tax provision, compliance, and controls, reporting to the Head of Tax. ElevenLabs operates through its US entity and ~9 international entities and is growing fast, which means the provision, the compliance calendar, and the controls around them need a dedicated owner. This is a hands-on ownership role. The provision and returns are prepared by external providers; you manage those engagements and are accountable for the output. You'll own the quarterly and annual ASC 740 provision (deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate rec, footnote disclosures), the US federal and state compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimated payments), and the technical work underneath it: §174 capitalization, §382 and NOL tracking. You'll also assist in designing, documenting, and operating controls, and write the memos that support our positions, working directly with our Big 4 advisors and external auditors alongside the Head of Tax. REQUIREMENTS - Deep ASC 740 expertise at a multinational — provision, deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate reconciliation, and footnote disclosure - Experience owning a US federal and multistate compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimates) - Working knowledge of US international provisions (NCTI/GILTI, Subpart F, FDDEI, §163(j)) and how they flow into the provision - Experience managing Big 4 or equivalent providers and working directly with external auditors - Has built or operated SOX controls over tax, or supported a first SOX implementation - CPA Bonus: pre-IPO or first-10-K experience, §174/§41 computation, §382 studies, equity compensation tax (ISOs, NSOs, RSUs), OneSource Tax Provision or similar. GROWTH POTENTIAL We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: - Build and lead the direct tax team as we bring provision and compliance in-house - Expand into other strategic initiatives such as M&A, PE mitigation policy, corporate structuring. - Broaden into wider tax leadership as our footprint grows LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere on the east coast, New York preferred. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Education Content Marketing Lead
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI’s Education team is building products and programs that advance how people learn with AI. We work across students, educators, institutions, and education communities to help people use AI thoughtfully and effectively. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for an Education Content Marketing Lead who combines exceptional editorial and curriculum judgment with strong content-marketing instincts, a builder’s mindset, and an engineer’s approach to scale. You’ll create high-quality content and the systems that move it from idea to published asset quickly and consistently. This is a hands-on role spanning long-form editorial, curriculum, video, visual content, channel strategy, and content operations. You’ll turn strategic briefs and expert input into useful work for students, educators, institutional leaders, and education communities; grow the channels that reach them; and use data to improve both the content and the engine behind it. Education needs a coherent, measurable content engine across audiences, formats, and channels. This role will turn fragmented requests and one-off production into a prioritized portfolio, reusable workflows, dependable creative capacity, and education-specific channels that compound over time. The goal is not simply to produce more content, but to create work that earns attention, supports learning and engagement, and improves through evidence. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Build and continuously improve a scalable content operating system spanning intake, prioritization, resourcing, production, review, publishing, versioning, and reuse. - Apply an engineer’s mindset to map dependencies, remove bottlenecks, automate repeatable work, create modular templates and playbooks, and maintain clear quality standards. - Maintain a single source of truth for the roadmap, editorial calendar, briefs, source material, production status, approvals, assets, and metadata. - Produce and edit content across formats, including long-form articles, blogs, case studies, web and email copy, social posts, educator stories, GIFs, images, and carousels. - Develop practical curriculum and professional-learning resources, including lesson plans, educator guides, AI literacy materials, decks, and train-the-trainer content. - Lead video development from concept through final cut, including story development, scripting, structural editing, interview preparation, and oversight of production and post-production partners. - Own and grow education-specific channels across social, email, websites, and blogs through clear audience strategies, editorial plans, and consistent publishing programs. - Set ambitious growth and engagement goals, define measures of content quality and efficacy, instrument tracking, analyze performance, and use experiments to improve results. - Turn goals and expert input into clear briefs, plans, timelines, and review paths in partnership with Content, Customer Education, Design, Marketing, Product, Research, Policy, Safety, Sales, Partnerships, and Customer Success. - Scale production by sourcing, onboarding, and managing a flexible bench of writers, editors, curriculum developers, designers, video partners, agencies, and other vendors. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Have significant experience in content production, content marketing, editorial leadership, curriculum development, instructional design, or creative production. - Bring a strong portfolio demonstrating excellent writing and editing across long-form editorial, curriculum or professional learning, video, social, and visual content. - Have built or materially improved content systems, workflows, templates, governance, tooling, automation, or publishing operations. - Have owned digital channels and used audience and performance data to set ambitious growth goals, design experiments, and deliver measurable results. - Are a strong video storyteller, with experience in scripting, structural editing, interview preparation, and collaboration with production and post-production specialists. - Can turn ambiguous, cross-functional input into clear requirements and polished work while sequencing priorities across multiple workstreams. - Have experience sourcing and onboarding external partners and are fluent with content-management, digital-asset-management, project-management, analytics, and automation tools. NICE TO HAVE - Experience working in education, edtech, AI, or another technical field. - Experience creating both curriculum or professional-learning resources and audience-facing marketing content. items.title: Procurement Operations Business Partner, Technology
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Procurement Operations is the front door for buying at Anthropic. We sit inside Finance Operations and own the path from “I need to buy something” to a signed agreement, an accurate purchase order, and clean spend data at month end. We are hiring a Procurement Operations Business Partner to own that path for our technology spend: business applications, SaaS tools, cloud and infrastructure services, and the engineering and developer tools our teams build with. This portfolio is software heavy: new tools evaluated and onboarded regularly, licenses that renew on their own schedule, and vendors billed on seats, usage, or tiered subscription terms rather than a single invoice. You will be the person who makes buying software feel simple to the teams who depend on it and reliable to the Finance stakeholders behind it. This is a high-volume role with an accounting core. You ensure every software purchase in your portfolio is coded, dated, received, and accrued correctly, so spend is right in the books every month. Expect a steady queue of new tool requests, renewals, and license changes, and expect to be the person Accounting trusts on all of it. We use Claude as part of our daily workflow and are looking for someone who wants to help define what an AI-native procurement operations function looks like, including how AI changes intake, contract and security review, vendor coordination, and requester support. Responsibilities Own the purchasing process Manage a high volume of purchase requests, renewals, and license changes each month across the organization, keeping speed and accuracy high at the same time. Serve as the primary procurement partner for the teams buying in your categories, guiding requesters from initial request to signed agreement and issued purchase order. Review every purchase request in your portfolio for the things that matter downstream: the right vendor record and contracting entity, complete commercial documents, correct spend categorization and service dates, and the approvals the purchase actually needs. Determine what else each request requires before it can move, whether that is an order form, a data privacy review, or a third party risk assessment, and route it to the right reviewers the first time. Partner with Security to run a vendor security review on every new tool and at every renewal, and hold the line that nothing goes live without one. Launch and track contract review with Legal, keep it moving, and confirm the executed agreement supports the purchase order before it is issued. Structure purchase orders so they match how the vendor bills (seat-based, usage-based, tiered subscription, or flat annual fee) and how Accounting needs to see the spend, with the right GL account, cost center, and service period on every line. Manage renewals, true ups, and seat count changes over the life of each agreement. Track license counts and renewal dates across your portfolio so nothing auto-renews or lapses by surprise, and flag underused or overlapping tools to budget owners ahead of the next renewal cycle. Financial completeness and accuracy Code every purchase order correctly at creation, including GL account, spend category, cost center, and service period, and understand how each choice lands in the financials (expense versus prepaid, annual versus monthly recognition). Work the hard cases with Accounting: multi year subscriptions paid upfront, mid term seat additions, true ups, credits, and contracts amended mid cycle. Own the open purchase order book: receipts recorded against actual delivery, periodic reviews, stale line cleanup, coding corrections, and timely closures, so PO, receipt, and invoice agree. Serve as the first line reviewer for month-end accruals on your portfolio, gathering estimates from vendors and budget owners for variable spend and confirming or correcting proposed amounts so Accounting can close on time. Partner with Accounts Payable to resolve invoice holds, PO mismatches, and receiving questions so vendors are paid on time and spend lands where it belongs. Support audit and reporting requests that touch your portfolio, including commitment schedules and control evidence, with data you can stand behind. Be the front door Be visible and responsive in your teams' Slack channels and office hours; answer routine purchasing questions quickly and escalate real blockers with context. Apply purchasing policy consistently and explain the why, including approval thresholds, signature authority, and when an exception is and is not available. Translate procurement, legal, security, and finance requirements into plain language for engineers, IT, and business stakeholders, and carry their operating reality back to those teams so controls fit the work. Keep a regular check in with your highest volume teams so upcoming purchases and renewals are visible early and nothing urgent arrives as a surprise. Continuous improvement Maintain the playbooks, intake guidance, and standard operating procedures for your portfolio so the path is repeatable and does not live in one person's head. Identify manual steps, repeat questions, and failure points and fix them, including where Claude and workflow automation with AI can take work off requesters and the team. Minimum qualifications Proven track record of owning a high-volume purchasing portfolio end-to-end in a procure-to-pay and intake platform. Solid working knowledge of accrual accounting as it applies to purchasing: accruals and reversals, service period and cutoff, prepaid versus expense, and GL and cost center coding. You can explain how a purchase order becomes an entry in the general ledger. Experience buying and managing software or SaaS at scale, including seat-based, usage-based, and tiered subscription billing models. Experience owning the tool and vendor lifecycle end to end, from intake through security review, contracting, renewal, and sunset, with the judgment to know when to push a request through and when to slow it down. Preferred qualifications 7+ years of procurement operations, purchasing, or vendor operations, including time supporting IT, engineering, or business systems teams. Background in accounting, accounts payable, or a month-end close process. Direct experience with Zip, Workday Financials, and Ironclad. Prior ownership of month-end accrual review or open PO reconciliation for a large, variable spend portfolio. Experience with software asset management or license optimization, including identifying underused or redundant tools. Experience designing tiered intake or approval frameworks that sped up low risk purchases without weakening controls. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $190,000 — $230,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. At Robinhood, the Physical Security team lives by a core value: Safety Always. We are dedicated to safeguarding our employees, workspace, and customers—putting their safety and security first in all our actions. We are dedicated to protecting people, assets, and the Robinhood brand while maintaining operational resilience across all environments. We're looking for a Senior Physical Security Operations Manager to drive global security programming across multiple countries, time zones, and complex third-party vendor workforces. In this critical role, you'll take a hands-on approach to shape and implement security policies, manage our uniformed security officers and emergency response team members, manage event security strategy, handle budgets, conduct facility risk assessments, and lead training initiatives for Robinhood’s global Physical Security Operations team. You'll play a key part in helping Robinhood prevent, respond to, and recover from security incidents—protecting both our people and our spaces. In this role, you will report directly to the Director of Physical Security. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 5 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Manage daily operations for an expanding international and domestic contracted physical security officer and emergency response force Draft, review, and put into effect policies for the safety and protection of our global operations Develop, implement, and be responsible for formal training programs for security officer roles including, standard operating procedures, incident response protocols, communication plans, etc. Work closely with team members across different areas to set up security protocols for domestic and international office expansions Display unwavering dedication to upholding the highest ethical standards, demonstrating a track record in managing highly confidential and sensitive information Develop and implement an event security program for large international marketing events/product launches and also manage internal employee events. Develop event security plan frameworks alongside key partners. Be responsible for facility risk assessments and propose key risk-management actions Coordinate efforts with cross-functional partners on projects including the response to security concerns Participate as a key member of the Crisis Management Program supporting incident response plans, emergency action plans, and more Deliver core security solutions, alternatives and recommendations in support of Executives What you bring Demonstrated experience and success in a corporate security operations leadership role Demonstrated experience and success leading and developing security operations teams globally 7+ years of vendor management experience Experience planning, leading and delivering advanced global protective strategies Experience with corporate security systems and operations Proven results leading security program automation and implementation Ability to travel between offices regionally and globally Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, working autonomously, and navigate ambiguity with ease Experience building and scaling operations in a high-growth, rapidly adapting environment Experience managing, coaching, and retaining talent Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information with discretion and emotional intelligence Experience in change management, administration, and vendor management What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
